title: Attendance History in the Appointment Series No-Show Fee — Questions Answered
content:
Training questions on the attendance share in the no-show fee of an Appointment Series.

**The rule.** The no-show attendance share is 90 percent where the series shows at least 8 attended appointments, 95 percent where it shows at least 4 but fewer than 8 attended appointments, and 100 percent where it shows fewer than 4. The share is read as a percentage of the no-show basis and multiplies it.

**Which attendances count?** Every attended appointment recorded on the series itself.

**A series shows exactly 8 attended appointments — which share?** 90 percent.

**And 7?** 95 percent, as for 4, 5 or 6.

**And 3?** 100 percent, as for none at all.

**Example (hypothetical figures).** A series showing 5 attended appointments, on a no-show basis of USD 85.00: 95 percent of USD 85.00 is USD 80.75.
